Start date: 1140-11-07  
Add 40 weeks = 280 days.  
Add 2 more days = 282 days total.  

1140 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and 1140 mod 100 = 40 ≠ 0, so leap).  
From 1140-11-07:  
Days remaining in November: 30 - 7 = 23 days → 282 - 23 = 259 days left.  
December: 31 days → 259 - 31 = 228 days left.  
1141 is not leap (1141 mod 4 = 1).  
January 1141: 31 → 197 left.  
February: 28 → 169 left.  
March: 31 → 138 left.  
April: 30 → 108 left.  
May: 31 → 77 left.  
June: 30 → 47 left.  
July: 31 → 16 left.  
August: 16 days → 1141-08-16.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1141-08-16
